| Category = Pasta recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

'''Pasta romanov''' is an easy recipe that can be whipped up in about 15 minutes from minimal ingredients for maximum style.

==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Pasta|Pasta]] (taglietelli, spaghetti, or angel hair preferred)
* [[Cookbook:Mascarpone Cheese|Mascarpone cheese]] (or similar mild cheese like [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta]])
* [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|Tomato purée]] (paste)
* [[Cookbook:Vodka|Vodka]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Caviar|caviar]] (or lumpfish [[Cookbook:Roe|roe]])
* Whole [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] a pot of salted water, add the pasta, and cook until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]]. Drain.  
# Melt the cheese (do not overheat) and stir in a little tomato puree to turn it salmon pink.
# Add a slug (a couple tablespoons) of vodka to the melted cheese.
# Add caviar to the cheese and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] the drained pasta in it to coat.
# Cut lemon into wedges and use as garnish with a teaspoon or two of caviar.
# Serve with champagne or crisp white wine.
